Job Title: SEO Specialist AI, Content & Organic Growth Location: Bangalore
 Experience: 5+ Years 
 Employment Type: Full-time Job Summary We are looking for an experienced SEO Specialist with strong hands-on expertise in AI-driven SEO, On-Page, Off-Page, Organic SEO, and blog/content optimization . The candidate will be responsible for improving search visibility, rankings, CTR through meta titles/descriptions , and organic traffic using data-driven and content-led SEO strategies. Key Responsibilities AI-Driven & Organic SEO Use AI-powered SEO tools (ChatGPT,Gemini, copilot ,Perplexity, Surfer SEO, Clearscope, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog) for keyword research, content ideation, and optimization Optimize content for search intent, semantic SEO, AI Overviews (SGE), and voice search On-Page SEO Optimize meta titles and meta descriptions to improve SERP visibility and click-through rate (CTR) Perform on-page audits including headings, URLs, internal linking, image alt tags, schema markup Improve Core Web Vitals, mobile usability, page speed, and crawlability Blog & Content SEO Plan, write, edit, and optimize SEO-friendly blogs and landing page content Conduct keyword mapping and topic clustering for blog content Optimize existing blogs for ranking improvement and content freshness Ensure content aligns with E-E-A-T guidelines and brand tone Collaborate with content writers/designers to ensure SEO best practices are followed Off-Page SEO Execute ethical link-building strategies (guest posts, outreach, digital PR) Monitor backlink profile, anchor text, and domain authority growth Analytics & Reporting Track performance using Google Analytics, Search Console, and SEO dashboards Monitor rankings, impressions, CTR, organic traffic, and conversions Prepare weekly/monthly SEO and content performance reports Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelors degree in Marketing, Communications, IT, or related field Proven experience in On-Page, Off-Page, Content, and Organic SEO Strong experience in blog writing, blog optimization, and content strategy Expertise in meta title and meta description optimization Hands-on experience with AI-based SEO tools and analytics platforms Excellent written communication and analytical skills Good to Have Experience in AI / SaaS / B2B content marketing Knowledge of technical SEO, JavaScript SEO, or automation Experience in content calendars and editorial planning Familiarity with CMS platforms (WordPress, Webflow, Headless CMS)

Key Skills: On-Page Optimization,Blogs,Organic SEO,SEO,Off-Page Optimization,Screaming Frog,Ctr,Off Page SEO
